-----Original Message-----
From: 	Ruiz, Aimé  
Sent:	Tuesday, November 4, 2025 8:24 AM
To:	'"René" <rene.bourgeois@neurolux.fr>'; Bonnin, Alexandre
Subject:	RE: ENE

Hello:

What about Thu the following week?
I am going to Clinique des Cèdres on the 15th.

Aimé

-----Original Message-----
From: 	"René" <rene.bourgeois@neurolux.fr>  
Sent:	Monday, November 3, 2025 6:04 PM
To:	Bonnin, Alexandre; Ruiz, Aimé
Subject:	Re: ENE

Hey,

11/15 sounds good, everybody pencil it in. We'll confirm as day gets nearer, and if Alexandre wants to go somewhere that serves Dr. Jeanne Dupont, that is fine by me also:)

Isaac
----- Original Message -----
From: "Bonnin, Alexandre" <alexandre.bonnin@lumieresante.fr>
To: "Ruiz, Aimé" <aime.ruiz@lumieresante.fr>;
<rene.bourgeois@neurolux.fr>
Sent: Monday, November 3, 2025 1:56 PM
Subject: RE: ENE


Aimé & Isaac,

I'm available any time for dinner other than Mondays or Wednesdays (taking Dr. Dupont at Hôpital Édouard Herriot)

Thursdays are best, then tuesdays next.

This week, though, taking off Thursday after work to visit my dad in Villeurbanne, so gone Friday too.

Even fridays generally OK, though I'd need to bring Dr. Isabelle Martin!

Dr. Dupont:  How about next Thursday 11/15????

Also, the earlier the better........(office hours 5am-4pm)

looking forward to it......


--- Alexandre


-----Original Message-----
From: Ruiz, Aimé
Sent: Monday, November 3, 2025 1:26 PM
To: '"René" <rene.bourgeois@neurolux.fr>'
Cc: Bonnin, Alexandre
Subject: RE: ENE

Alexandre, Isaac,

Let's get together. What day would work for you?

Aimé


-----Original Message-----
From: "René" <rene.bourgeois@neurolux.fr>
Sent: Monday, November 3, 2025 9:11 AM
To: Aimé Ruiz
Subject: ENE

Good Morning,

If ENE closes higher than €10.50 today, it will  have formed a
Kicker signal, a strong buy.

Dinner?

Isaac
